title: BLACKBERRY ICE – IGET SHION – 600 PUFFS
description:
IGET SHION BLACKBERRY ICE – 600 PUFFS

IGET are pre-infused with a variety of salt nicotine flavours. The device is super sleek, stylish, comfortable to use, and effortless to carry. This single use vaporiser is the bestselling disposable e-cigarette at IGET Tech.

The iGet is a disposable vape pod device E-cigarette with a 400mAh & more than 600+ puffs. Theyboast a small size, tasty flavours and an efficient vaping experience, Easy to carry, enjoy anywhere.

Choose the flavour you love most from the iGet. If you like fruity and delicious flavours, this is the one for you.

– Package Includes: Single iGet Bar

– No need to charge

– Pre-filled, no need for messy refills

– Lots of flavours to choice

Please allow 1-3 business days for the order to arrive.
